subject: design/argus-attribution-hardening
statement: Forgery-resistant strength comes from **two repo-internal properties, no new key**: the producer is architecturally out of the adversary-drive's reach (§3.1), and the trailer carries an **in-tree binding to the commit's own content** — a binding the gate re-derives from the commit via `git` — so a trailer replayed onto a different commit fails the binding and derives *underivable*. The CI read stays credential-free and badge-independent, exactly as shipped *(design-brainstorm:argus-attribution-hardening-tech-design#D-2)*.
